note: Baseline collected before performance optimizations. Times represent typical cold-start response times observed in dev logs.

/api/overview.note: Runs 12 parallel queries via Promise.all + getCoreMetrics (15 queries). Dominated by complex CTEs.

/api/clinicians.note: 3 parallel queries. getCoreMetrics cached on repeat.

/api/managers.note: 3 parallel queries. getCoreMetrics cached on repeat.

/api/issues.note: 11 parallel queries, no date filter, no cache prior to optimisation.

/api/monitoring/top-performers.note: Single complex query with per-day breakdown.

/api/daily-review.note: Multiple summary queries for a single date.

/api/centres.note: Multiple CTEs for centre health + getCoreMetrics.

knownBottlenecks: PatientAuditLog scans without composite index on (AdminUserId, CreatedDateTime)
AllocatePatient joins without index on (ClinicianUserId, Status)
Cold container start adds ~800ms on first request after idle period
No compression on API responses (avg JSON payload ~45KB for /api/overview)
Issues route runs 11 queries with no cache — single-user refresh costs full DB round-trip
